## What changes
<!-- One or two lines. -->

## Kind
- [ ] Code (generator, CLI, plugin, builder)
- [ ] Library pack (topic / tone / theme / faith)
- [ ] Docs / site

## Checklist
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes; golden files updated with `-update` and the diff reviewed
- [ ] Packs: version bumped (patch = typo/sample, minor = sources/angles, major = the bar changed) and CHANGELOG line added
- [ ] Packs: `briefly4u lint-packs library/` passes (schema, samples labelled, contrast, no secrets)
- [ ] No private data (names, emails, ids, message text) and no credentials anywhere
- [ ] Samples invented and labelled EXAMPLE (no real news items)
- [ ] Safety ground rules untouched, or the change is called out for review
